The picture was made with the Warcraft III map editor.]] The Void terrors are huge and extremly powerful two-headed [[demon]]s. These beasts of demonic power possess a nearly unlimited source of demonic energy.
The only known Void terror in Azeroth (Kalimdor) is [[Immol'thar]] in [[Dire Maul]].
